summary: Frontend-only testing of completely redesigned ApplicationsIndex and ApplicationDetail pages. All 10 industries display uniformly with cards showing icons, titles, descriptions, and spec badges. Project gallery shows 8 curated installation images with working category filters and modal. Detail pages have dramatic 70vh heroes with background images, real-world installations galleries, and challenges with icons.

features_tested.details: All 10 industries display uniformly: Shopfront Signage, Hospitality & Hotels, Retail & Malls, Corporate & Offices, Healthcare, Transportation, Entertainment, Sports & Events, Education, Outdoor & Billboards
Each card shows: icon container, title (h3), description, 2 spec badges (brightness + pixel pitch)

Gallery shows 8 real installation images (no white-background product images): Dubai Mall Atrium, Dubai Marina Billboard, Abu Dhabi Hotel Lobby, Stadium Scoreboard, Corporate Boardroom, Hospital Wayfinding, Cinema LED Screen, Airport Terminal Display
9 filter buttons work correctly: All Projects, Retail, Outdoor, Hospitality, Sports, Corporate, Healthcare, Entertainment, Transportation. Clicking filter updates gallery content.
Clicking gallery image opens full-screen modal with navigation (prev/next) buttons and close button. Modal navigation works correctly.
70vh hero section with full-width background image, gradient overlays, large icon, title, tagline, description, and CTA buttons
70vh hero section with corporate boardroom background image, 'CORPORATE & OFFICES' title, 'Professional Display Solutions for Modern Workplaces' tagline
4 specs displayed with icons below hero: Healthcare (300-600 nits, P1.2-P2.5, PWM 3,840 Hz+, IP30+ Sealed), Corporate (400-800 nits, P0.7-P1.9, Built-in 4K, HDMI 2.1/USB-C)
'Real-World Installations' gallery section with 2 clickable images. Clicking opens modal.
4 challenge cards each with cyan icon container (bg-cyan-500/10). Corporate challenges: Seamless Presentations, All-Day Viewing, IT Integration, Professional Aesthetics
'Get Quote' links to /contact, 'View Case Studies' links to /case-studies
'Get Quote' CTA navigates to /contact, 'View Solutions' navigates to relevant solution page
